name: Instructor
one_liner: Structured extraction from models into typed objects.
what_it_is: A library focused on one thing, structured extraction, in its own words, providing automatic validation, retries, streaming and nested object support. A response is parsed into a declared type and re-requested when it does not conform.
why_it_matters: It turns "the model usually returns valid JSON" into a typed object or an error, which is the difference between a parsing bug and a caught failure. The retries are not free: a schema the model finds hard to satisfy becomes repeated calls, and the cost shows up as latency and spend rather than as an exception.
suitable_for: Pulling fields out of unstructured text into a known shape
Pipelines where a malformed response must fail rather than propagate
Work where the output type is already declared in code
not_suitable_for: Free-form generation with no schema to hold it to
Cost-sensitive paths where retry loops are hard to bound
Cases where the provider’s own structured-output mode already suffices
